automatable_note: A jumper must be fitted and removed by hand during every program. The bench cannot do this.

manual.action: Fit the jumper on the programming contacts.
Pull the jumper off as soon as the drive battery is connected.
manual.action_de: Jumper abziehen, sobald der Antriebsakku angesteckt ist.

manual.action: Current regulation and reset: fit the jumper again when the program asks; a start button is pressed and let go.
manual.action_de: Stromregelung und Reset: Jumper wieder stecken, wenn das Programm es verlangt; Starttaster drücken und loslassen.

entry.confirm_signal: Signal after jumper removal; 3-fold signal after about 5 s for the current limit; 6-fold signal about 30 s after reset beeps.
steps: Stick-way teach-in: throttle at motor-off (stick back), jumper on, radio on; apply power, pull the jumper; a signal; move to full; a signal; for throttle compensation move to motor-off, otherwise wait; 2 beeps = without, 3 beeps = with; optional start button press; 2 or 3 beeps; disconnect power.

Current limit: throttle at full, jumper on, radio on; apply power, pull the jumper; a signal; wait about 5 s for the 3-fold signal; count the beeps (5 A each); move the throttle out of full at the wanted count; the ESC repeats the value; fit the jumper again for current regulation; two beeps; disconnect power.

Reset: any throttle position; jumper on, radio on; apply power, pull the jumper; the ESC beeps several times; about 30 s after the last signal a 6-fold signal arrives; LED flashes continuously; disconnect power.

announce.description: After the wait signal the ESC sounds one beep per 5 A (current limit); confirmation of throttle compensation is 2 or 3 beeps.

select.description: Move the throttle out of full at the wanted count.

skip.description: Disconnect power to abandon a program.

scheme.confirm_signal: 2 or 3 beeps after stick-way teach-in; the current value repeated as beeps.
scheme.reset_to_defaults: Reset program: jumper, power, 30 s, 6-fold signal.
scheme.description: Three jumper-and-signals programs for the helicopter ESC: stick ways with throttle compensation, current limit and reset. Undervoltage cutoff is not available (disabled).

items.name: Stick positions (motor-off, full) with throttle compensation and start button

values.name: taught by the sequence; throttle compensation on: throttle to motor-off after the full signal, confirmed by 3 beeps; off: wait, confirmed by 2 beeps
each beep counted = 5 A; throttle leaves full at the wanted count
reset: about 30 s after the last signal a 6-fold signal arrives; LED flashes continuously

unknowns: Signal is an LED flash plus a beep with the motor connected; beep duration and gaps are not stated.
Time allowed between steps is not stated except the 'about 5 s' wait for the 3-fold or 4-fold signal and about 30 s for the reset.
How the ESC decides between stick-way teach-in and brake-strength entry when both start with the stick back and the jumper pulled at power-up is not stated in the text.
Item numbers are the signal counts where the manual gives them; item 1 is the stick-way teach-in, which has no count.
Which stick position starts which program after the jumper is pulled is read from the drawings only.
notes: The ESC only releases the motor in the motor-off position (stick back); there is no brake position.
